Overview

Tallahassee is a city in FL with a population of 196,169. Florida’s capital with FSU Seminoles, oak canopy roads, and no state income tax. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
